issues.desc: CHK-002 remains broad: a single item maps EvidenceEnvelope, receipts, trust level, provider/model/vendor/run ids, verification context pack, gate consumption, and authority modes across three repos. Non-blocking for INIT_CHECK, but the implementer should sub-structure this in PLAN/plan.md with per-surface DoneWhen so coverage is checkable rather than one open-ended deliverable. Prior medium (CHK-001 green-preset userSees) and lows (CHK-003 Codex-gate visibility, arbitrary backlog refs, manual_transcript capture) are all confirmed digested in the current files.
